_about: Factions a player can pick in the pass-and-play Duel. deck = [decks.json key, 'player'|'enemy']. empire is the rules empire (its passive applies). ground is the battlefield painting. Add a faction here to add it to the picker. hq (Durg hit points) is the balance lever, tuned by simulation (see DESIGN.md, Duel balance). Decks are padded to 52 cards in code (DUEL_DECK_SIZE). kosha (starting Kosha ceiling, default 1) is a second lever, used for Gupta.
